up: Retrieve the compound name (pref_name), molecule ChEMBL ID, standard activity value, standard units, and standard activity type for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4725212. Only include exact activity values where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Join activities with assays on assay_id and with molecule_dictionary on molregno. Do not apply a LIMIT clause.
sql: SELECT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_type FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4725212' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
